title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: STEERING INTERLOCK ASSEMBLY (372,593 affected)

summary: TOYOTA IS RECALLING CERTAIN MODEL YEAR 2003-2007 LEXUS LX470 VEHICLES. IF THE SNAP RING BECOMES DISENGAGED AND THE STEERING WHEEL IS THEN REPEATEDLY TURNED TO THE LOCKED POSITION, OVER TIME THE STEERING SHAFT MAY BECOME DISCONNECTED.

title: Dutchmen Manufacturing, Inc.: CERTIFICATION LABEL/ PART 567 (135 affected)

title: Turtle Top: WHEELCHAIR LIFTS/INTERLOCK BELT (138 affected)

title: Turtle Top: WHEELCHAIR LIFTS/UP BUTTON (14 affected)
